class.name: VCSVEditorImportPlugin
class.brief_description:
Editor import plugin that turns .csv/.tsv files into VCSVDataTable .tres resources.
把 .csv/.tsv 文件导入为 VCSVDataTable .tres 资源的编辑器导入插件。
class.description:
Registered at editor init and wired up by the add-on's [code]editor_plugin.gd[/code]. Claims [code]csv[/code]/[code]tsv[/code] with priority 2.0 (above Godot's built-in translation importer) unless the project setting [code]vortariscsv/import/override_translation_importer[/code] is disabled — then it drops to 0.5 and individual files can still be switched via the Import dock's *Import As* menu. Configurable per-file options appear in the Import dock: delimiter (Comma/Tab/Semicolon/Space/Custom, with a custom single-character field), quote, header, key column, row type, type detection, an explicit [code]column_types[/code] text field (e.g. [code]hp:int;attack:float[/code], which wins over detection), trimming, comments, array delimiter, null token and case sensitivity. The [code]delimiter[/code], [code]encoding[/code], [code]auto_detect_delimiter[/code] and [code]header_rows[/code] defaults come from the [code]vortariscsv/import/*[/code] project settings; newly imported tables default to [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code] and [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code].
在编辑器初始化时注册，由插件的 [code]editor_plugin.gd[/code] 挂载。以优先级 2.0 接管 [code]csv[/code]/[code]tsv[/code]（高于内置翻译导入器），除非项目设置 [code]vortariscsv/import/override_translation_importer[/code] 被关闭——此时降为 0.5，单个文件仍可在导入面板的 *Import As* 菜单中切换。导入面板提供每文件可配置项：分隔符（Comma/Tab/Semicolon/Space/Custom，自定义时提供单字符输入框）、引号、表头、键列、行类型、类型检测、显式 [code]column_types[/code] 文本框（如 [code]hp:int;attack:float[/code]，优先于检测）、修剪、注释、数组分隔符、空值标记和大小写。[code]delimiter[/code]、[code]encoding[/code]、[code]auto_detect_delimiter[/code]、[code]header_rows[/code] 的默认值取自 [code]vortariscsv/import/*[/code] 项目设置；新建的导入表默认采用 [code]vortariscsv/general/lazy_build_default[/code] 与 [code]vortariscsv/general/hot_reload_default[/code]。
